name: dense_native_relative_only
hypothesis: Suppress absolute RGB/paper feature shortcuts by using only the three source-estimated relative OD channels
rationale: Matched photometry gains only one selected held red point over sparse/dense controls and paper errors persist; invariant-input ablation tests a more direct restriction
control: Matched dense_native: same crop anchors, points, paper regions, source texture, optimizer, losses; only input six absolute channels zeroed in every forward
model_selection: Fixed final8000 for all folds; no checkpoint choice
prohibition: Do not fit to validation, external or prospective points; no novelty claim for relative colour or feature masking
limits: Source-estimated paper may include stain or broad red ink; OD is gamma-RGB approximation, not recovered chemistry
